calculation: Eligible amount: phone claimed at $1,099, capped at the Economy per-item limit of $150 (policy POL-2007 has no Electronics Plus add-on, so the limit is not raised to $1,200) = $150. Nothing paid by a carrier or other party for the same loss = $0 off. Deductible for Baggage and Personal Effects (Economy) of $100 comes off once per claim: $150 - $100 = $50. Result $50 is below the Baggage and Personal Effects maximum of $750. Payout = $50.00.
section_reliance: Policy Wording section 5 (Baggage and Personal Effects), read with section 1 (Economy per-item limit $150 and $100 deductible) and section 8 (Electronics Plus add-on not held); payout worked under section 10 and Claims Manual section 6.
reason: The phone was accidentally damaged during the covered trip and the required documents (a repair shop statement that it is beyond economic repair and a replacement receipt as proof of value) are on file, so the claim is covered under section 5. As the policy is Economy with no Electronics Plus add-on, the per-item limit caps this item at $150, and after the $100 Baggage deductible the payable amount is $50.
